title: Approximate Dynamic Programming with Basis Function Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.24737v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This work presents a novel approach for approximating the value function in Markov decision processes (MDPs). Our approach is grounded in the approximate linear programming (ALP) framework, wherein basis functions (BFs) play an important role. Traditionally, BFs have been pre-defined, randomly generated, or restricted to specific structures, which both limits the accuracy that can be achieved and leaves no mechanism for improving a given approximation. We instead learn BFs from the model itself, by repeatedly applying the Bellman operator to the current value estimate. We introduce the Bellman operator basis function (BOBF) learning method, and prove that each learned BF improves the approximation by a quantifiable amount and that the method converges to the optimal value function. Its shrunken counterpart (SBOBF) retains this guarantee while capping the number of BFs, and therefore the computational effort per iteration. For large-scale

translated_title: 基于基函数学习的近似动态规划
translated_abstract: 本工作提出了一种在马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）中近似值函数的新方法。我们的方法建立在近似线性规划（ALP）框架之上，其中基函数（BF）扮演着重要角色。传统上，基函数通常是预先定义的、随机生成的或局限于特定结构的，这既限制了所能达到的精度，也没有提供改进给定近似的机制。我们转而从模型本身学习基函数，即通过反复将Bellman算子应用于当前的值估计。我们引入了Bellman算子基函数（BOBF）学习方法，并证明每个学习到的基函数都能以可量化的幅度改进近似，且该方法收敛于最优值函数。其缩减版本（SBOBF）在保留上述保证的同时，限制了基函数的数量，从而限制了每次迭代的计算量。对于大规模……
tldr: 该论文提出BOBF方法，通过反复应用Bellman算子从模型本身学习基函数，保证每次学习都能以可量化幅度改进MDP值函数近似并收敛到最优值函数，其缩减版SBOBF还能在限制基函数数量和计算量的同时保留这些理论保证。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces BOBF, a method that learns basis functions directly from the model via repeated application of the Bellman operator, provably improving MDP value function approximations by quantifiable amounts with convergence guarantees, while its shrunken variant SBOBF retains these guarantees under a bounded number of basis functions.
